newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Victorias to pay for lost sugar.
newsitem.headline: Victorias to pay for lost sugar.

text.p: Victorias Milling Co Inc was committed to paying for the 31,000 tonnes of sugar lost warehouses which was earlier sold to the state-owned National Food Authority (NFA), Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Friday.
Escudero told reporters the president of Victorias promised to either replace the missing sugar worth 383.6 million pesos or make cash payments.
"We will implement the full force of the law," Escudero told reporters when asked about the lost sugar orders.
Escudero was meeting sugar farmers and millers in Bacolod City in central Philippines.
The NFA launched a sugar buying programme in February to beef up prices of domestic sugar.
Victorias was allowed last month by the Securities and Exchange Commission to suspend debt payments totalling 5.07 billion pesos because of its financial problems.
Victorias blamed its financial woes on the slump in the local sugar industry due to competition from cheaper imports.
